skill.name: 2026-coach
skill.description: Plan 2026 goals through guided discovery, quarterly milestones, controllable process goals, daily checklists, and weekly accountability reviews.
skill.summary: Turn annual goals into practical daily behaviors and weekly reviews.
skill.author: BayramAnnakov

security_audit.summary: All 27 static alerts are false positives caused by documentation links, installation paths, Markdown backticks, and ordinary coaching questions. remediation.issue: The skill opens with a direct role-reassignment instruction.
remediation.suggestion: Replace "You are now acting" with scoped guidance that preserves higher-priority instructions and limits the role to the requested coaching session.

content.value_statement: Annual goals often lack actionable daily steps. This skill converts one outcome into quarterly milestones, weekly process goals, and daily checklists.
actual_capabilities: Guides four discovery rounds covering current state, vision, strategy, and available time.
Synthesizes one annual outcome goal and asks the user to confirm or refine it.
Breaks the annual goal into quarterly milestones, weekly process goals, and measurable daily behaviors.
Creates an annual plan, coaching context, and first-week checklist in a user-approved location.
Guides weekly reviews covering completion, lessons, energy, blockers, and next-week adjustments.
Adapts question presentation when structured user-question tools are unavailable.
limitations: The workflow targets 2026 and requires manual adaptation for later years.
The published package lacks the referenced document templates, so output structure may vary by agent.
File creation depends on the host agent's tools and access to the user-approved location.
The cited effectiveness claim is presented from one source and is not independently validated by this skill.

use_cases.title: Founder Annual Plan
use_cases.description: Convert a revenue or validation target into quarterly milestones and daily outreach, product, or customer-learning actions.

use_cases.title: Leadership Priority System
use_cases.description: Turn a strategic business objective into weekly controllable actions and a recurring review process.

use_cases.title: Personal Development Routine
use_cases.description: Translate a writing, fitness, or career objective into realistic daily behaviors and weekly checklists.

prompt_templates.title: Define My 2026 Goal
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define one clear outcome goal for 2026. Ask about my current situation, desired result, constraints, and available time.

prompt_templates.title: Convert an Outcome to Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: My 2026 outcome goal is [goal]. Convert it into controllable weekly process goals and measurable daily behaviors that fit [time available].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Quarterly Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-quarter roadmap for [goal]. Define each milestone, its evidence of completion, weekly process targets, and likely constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Complete Coaching System
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full discovery workflow for [goal]. Challenge weak assumptions, compare tradeoffs, define quarterly milestones, create daily actions, and design weekly reviews.

output_examples.input: I want to reach 100 paying customers by December 2026.
output_examples.output: Outcome: 100 paying customers. Q1 validates demand. Weekly process: interview five prospects and send 50 targeted messages. Review conversion every Sunday.

output_examples.input: I want to finish a 60,000-word manuscript this year.
output_examples.output: Outcome: complete the manuscript. Daily process: write 300 words before other work. Weekly target: 1,500 words across five sessions.

output_examples.input: Review my week. I completed 16 of 25 planned outreach actions.
output_examples.output: Completion was 64 percent. Identify the strongest work window, remove one recurring blocker, and set a realistic next-week target with daily checkboxes.

best_practices: Share concrete constraints, available time, and one primary success metric.
Choose behaviors fully under your control and define a measurable daily target.
Complete the weekly review before changing targets or adding new goals.
anti_patterns: Do not use several competing annual goals as equal priorities.
Do not define process goals through outcomes controlled by customers, markets, or other people.
Do not increase daily targets without reviewing completion data and constraints.

faq.question: Does this skill only work for business goals?
faq.answer: No. It can structure career, writing, fitness, learning, and other goals with measurable daily behaviors.

faq.question: Must I use Claude Code?
faq.answer: No. The workflow supports Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and conversational agents, but file creation depends on available tools.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your current situation, desired 2026 result, primary metric, constraints, available time, and previous lessons.

faq.question: Where are coaching files saved?
faq.answer: The skill asks for a current, home, or custom directory before requesting file creation.

faq.question: Can it review progress each week?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews completed targets, lessons, energy, blockers, and adjustments for the next week.

faq.question: Does it guarantee goal completion?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning and accountability structure, but results depend on execution, circumstances, and the quality of chosen goals.
